Fractions compare, sort arithmetic numbers, adding number continues numbering. Absorbance columns new type, created absorbance(), records wavelength unit, AU mAU. Combining runs recorded different units kind, psi MPa, converts unit first, plots label volume axis unit. quantity_convert() quantity_unit() work . readers return chromatogram, tibble records instrument, run, date, method file, prints . chrom_meta() gives . chrom_fractions() gives start end volume fraction, row time fraction collected , collector starts first tube. chrom_add_volume() uses unit time column. fraction_to_well() gives well collection plate fraction went , wellr well IDs.
